# ModelDummyCreator

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Camera/ModelDummyCreator.cs#L45)

Takes a still of whatever this camera is pointed at and writes it into the project as a PNG -
the flat pictures of models a course uses for menus, labels and printed material.

An editor tool, not a runtime one: the camera renders one extra frame into an offscreen
texture when the button is pressed and everything it touched is put back afterwards. It
needs no play mode, changes nothing in the scene, and does nothing at all in a build.

The scene it was built for is a black room: a background plane big enough to fill the
frame with an unlit black material on it, one directional light at an angle that reads
well on the models, and the models themselves in front of this camera. Turn
[`transparentBackground`](/api/vrframework-core-runtime/ModelDummyCreator#transparentbackground) on instead when the picture is going over something
else and needs no background at all.

```csharp
[RequireComponent(typeof(Camera))]
[DisallowMultipleComponent]
public class ModelDummyCreator : MonoBehaviour
```

### transparentBackground {#transparentbackground}

```csharp
[Tooltip("Whether the background is left out of the picture instead of drawn.\n\nOff is the black-room setup: whatever the camera clears to, or the black plane behind the models, ends up in the PNG and the PNG has no alpha channel at all.\n\nOn clears the frame to nothing for the length of the capture, so only what was drawn is in the PNG. Post-processing fills the alpha channel back in, so turn it off on this camera if the picture comes out opaque anyway.")]
public bool transparentBackground
```
